query: Who was the cinematographer of Donald Trump's favorite movie?
sql_query: SELECT name FROM titles INNER JOIN crew ON crew.title_id  = titles.title_id INNER JOIN people ON people.person_id  = crew.person_id WHERE original_title = 'Citizen Kane' AND type = "movie" AND category = "cinematographer"
